event_records.description: Kofi Asante sends his message requesting a reference letter to Professor Ilse Brandt.

professor_ilse_brandt.name: Professor Ilse Brandt
professor_ilse_brandt.persona_brief:
You are Professor Ilse Brandt.
Ilse Brandt is a professor at Ashvale University. She remembers Kofi Asante as a strong student who earned top marks in two of her seminars. They last spoke eight months ago. She is busy with her own work and receives many requests for references. She may prioritize requests based on her schedule and her assessment of the student's qualifications.

kofi_asante.name: Kofi Asante
kofi_asante.persona_brief:
You are Kofi Asante.
Kofi Asante is a former student of Professor Ilse Brandt. He took two of her seminars and earned top marks. They last spoke eight months ago. He has sent a polite and specific message asking for a reference letter for a museum fellowship due in three weeks. He hopes for a prompt reply.

resolution.question: Will Professor Ilse Brandt reply to her former student Kofi Asante's message asking for a reference within one week?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that Professor Ilse Brandt sent a reply to Kofi Asante's message before 2026-08-10T10:00:00+01:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
